
```{r load_data_comparison, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
load("data/data.Rdata")
load("data/beta.Rdata")
load("data/hill.Rdata")
```

```{r configurating, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)

env_hill_df <- hill_long %>%
  rename(sample = id) %>%               # <-- Add this line if hill_long uses 'id'
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols      = sample,
    names_from   = q,
    values_from  = value,
    names_prefix = "env_hill_q"
  )

meta <- sample_metadata %>%
  left_join(env_hill_df, by = "sample")
```

```{r env0n alligning betamatrix, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dist_obj <- beta_q0n$S
samples <- attr(dist_obj, "Labels")
meta_aligned <- meta %>%
  filter(sample %in% samples) %>%
  arrange(match(sample, samples))
stopifnot(identical(meta_aligned$sample, samples))
hill_vars <- c("env_hill_qhill_q0", "env_hill_qhill_q1", "env_hill_qhill_q2")
for (v in hill_vars) {
  meta_tmp <- meta_aligned[, v, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(meta_tmp) <- "alpha"
  res <- adonis2(
    dist_obj ~ alpha,
    data = meta_tmp,
    permutations = 999
  )
  cat("\n--- PERMANOVA for", v, "---\n")
  print(res)
}
```

```{r visualisation0n connection1, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

nmds <- metaMDS(bray_dist0n, k = 2)
p1 <- as.data.frame(nmds$points)
nmds_points$env_hill_q0 <- meta_order0n$env_hill_qhill_q0  

ggplot(nmds_points, aes(MDS1, MDS2, color = env_hill_q0)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(color = "Environmental Hill q0")
```

```{r env_tertiles split}

meta$env_hill_q0_group <- cut_number(meta$env_hill_qhill_q0, n=3, labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))
table(meta$env_hill_q0_group)

meta$env_hill_q1_group <- cut_number(meta$env_hill_qhill_q1, n=3, labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))
table(meta$env_hill_q1_group)

meta$env_hill_q2_group <- cut_number(meta$env_hill_qhill_q2, n=3, labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))
table(meta$env_hill_q2_group)

```

```{r env_median, split}
# For Hill number q0
threshold_q0 <- median(meta$env_hill_qhill_q0, na.rm = TRUE)
meta$env_hill_q0_group <- ifelse(meta$env_hill_qhill_q0 <= threshold_q0, "Low", "High")
table(meta$env_hill_q0_group)

# For Hill number q1
threshold_q1 <- median(meta$env_hill_qhill_q1, na.rm = TRUE)
meta$env_hill_q1_group <- ifelse(meta$env_hill_qhill_q1 <= threshold_q1, "Low", "High")
table(meta$env_hill_q1_group)

# For Hill number q2
threshold_q2 <- median(meta$env_hill_qhill_q1, na.rm = TRUE)
meta$env_hill_q2_group <- ifelse(meta$env_hill_qhill_q2 <= threshold_q2, "Low", "High")
table(meta$env_hill_q2_group)
```
